Travel Guide to Paris

Paris is the capital of France and one of the most visited cities in the world. The Eiffel Tower is its most famous landmark, attracting millions of visitors each year.

The city is known for its art museums, cafes, and architectural landmarks. The Louvre Museum houses thousands of works including the Mona Lisa.

French cuisine is celebrated globally, and Paris has many Michelin-starred restaurants alongside charming local bistros.
